description_en: Queries the details of an exception. An alert event consists of an alert and exceptions. Each alert event is associated with multiple exceptions
description_zh: 查询单个告警事件详情
name: DescribeSuspEventDetail

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The data source of the exception. Set the value to sas
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件数据的来源，固定为sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

AlarmUniqueInfo.description_en:
The unique ID of the alarm event.
If querying the anomaly information of a single alarm event, you need to provide the unique ID of the alarm event, which can be obtained by calling the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) interface
AlarmUniqueInfo.description_zh:
告警事件的唯一标识ID。

如果查询单个告警事件的异常事件信息，需要提供告警事件的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口获取

CanBeDealOnLine.description_en:
Indicates whether the online processing of exceptions is supported, such as blocking an exception, adding an exception to the whitelist, and ignoring an exception. Valid values:

true: The online processing of exceptions is supported.
false: The online processing of exceptions is not supported
CanBeDealOnLine.description_zh:
是否支持在线处理告警事件，例如阻断隔离、加白名单、忽略等。取值包括：
true：支持在线处置
false：不支持在线处置

DataSource.description_en: The data source of the exception

Details.description_en: An array that consists of the details of the exception

NameDisplay.description_en: The display name of the alert event

Type.description_en:
The format in which the details of the exception are displayed.

Valid values:

text
html
Type.description_zh:
告警事件详情信息展示的方式。

取值包括：
text：文本方式
html：富文本的方式

Value.description_en: The attribute information about the exception. For example, if the exception is associated with an alert that is triggered by an unusual logon, the information can include the time when the logon is initiated and the location from which the logon is initiated. If the exception is associated with an alert that is triggered by a webshell file, the information can include the path of the trojan file and the type of the trojan
Value.description_zh: 告警事件的其他属性信息。例如：异常登录告警的登录时间或登录地点、webshell告警的木马文件路径或木马类型等

EventDesc.example: The detection model found a suspicious Webshell file on your server, which may be a backdoor file implanted to maintain permissions after the attacker successfully invaded the website.

EventStatus.description_en:
The status of the exception. Valid values:

1: pending handling
2: ignored
4: confirmed
8: marked as a false positive
16: handling
32: handled
64: expired
EventStatus.description_zh:
告警事件状态。取值包括：

1：pending（待处理）
2：ignore（已忽略）
4：handled（已确认）
8：fault（已标记误报）
16：dealing（处理中）
32：done（处理完毕）
64：expire（已经过期）

Id.description_zh: 记录告警事件的唯一标识ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server on which the exception was detected
InstanceName.description_zh: 发生告警事件的服务器的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server on which the exception was detected
InternetIp.description_zh: 发生告警事件的服务器的公网IP

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server on which the exception was detected
IntranetIp.description_zh: 发生告警事件的服务器的私网IP

LastTime.description_en: The time when the exception was last detected
LastTime.description_zh: 告警事件最新发生时间

Level.description_en:
The risk level of the exception. Valid values:

serious
suspicious
remind
Level.description_zh:
告警事件的危险等级。取值包括：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒

OperateErrorCode.description_en: The code that indicates the handling result of the exception

OperateMsg.description_en: The message that indicates the handling result of the exception
OperateMsg.description_zh: 告警事件的处理结果的说明

SaleVersion.description_en:
The edition of Security Center in which the exception can be detected. Valid values:

0: Basic edition
1: Advanced edition
2: Enterprise edition
SaleVersion.description_zh:
告警事件检测支持的云安全中心版本。取值包括：

0：基础版

1：高级版

2：企业版

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server on which the exception was detected
Uuid.description_zh: 发生告警事件的服务器实例的UUID
